question_cn: 中间招（Intermezzo / Zwischenzug / 「过渡」）的核心机制是什么？
question_en: What is the core idea of an intermezzo (Zwischenzug)?

options.text_cn: 在换子或吃子序列中，插入一步更强迫性的棋（如将军、捉挂子），迫使对方先应对，再回来完成换子
options.text_en: Insert a more forcing move, such as a check or an attack on a loose piece, during an exchange sequence; make the opponent respond first, then complete the exchange

options.text_cn: 主动移走己方棋子，为另一个己方棋子清出攻击路径
options.text_en: Move one of your own pieces to clear an attack line for another piece

options.text_cn: 牺牲子力将对方棋子引诱到不利位置，再实施叉击
options.text_en: Sacrifice material to lure an opposing piece onto an unfavorable square, then fork it

options.text_cn: 移走己方棋子，暴露其身后棋子的攻击线（闪击）
options.text_en: Move one of your own pieces to uncover an attack by a piece behind it (a discovered attack)

explanation_cn: 中间招的本质是「先插一刀」：当双方换子序列进行到一半时，不急着按顺序吃回，而是先走一步更强迫的棋（将军、捉挂子等），迫使对方先应对，然后再回来完成换子——净多赚一步先手收益。叶江川教材称之为「过渡」，与德语 Zwischenzug（中间棋）同义。
explanation_en: An intermezzo means inserting a forcing move into an exchange sequence instead of recapturing immediately. A check or an attack on a loose piece makes the opponent respond first; afterward, you return to the exchange and gain the benefit of that extra tempo. It is also known as a Zwischenzug.
